provenance.reasoning: DEPENDS_ON holds: coordination of collective action requires trust that others will fulfill their roles. Without trust, coordination collapses into paranoia or free-riding. This is present-tense necessity, not mere chronology.

DEPENDS_ON holds: reciprocity requires cooperation as its substrate. Without at least minimal cooperation from both parties, mutual exchange cannot occur. The other party must cooperate to receive and reciprocate benefits.

DEPENDS_ON holds: symbols require language as their enabling system. A symbol derives meaning from its position within a shared linguistic/sign system. Without language to encode and transmit symbolic meaning, the symbol is just a mark.

DEPENDS_ON holds: resistance (organized opposition to authority) requires law as its defining counterforce. Without law to resist against, there is no structured opposition — just chaos or preference. Resistance gets its shape and purpose from the legal/authority structure it opposes.

Cryptography is indeed a specific application domain within software — it implements algorithms as software to achieve secrecy/authentication. INSTANCE_OF (specific→general) is the right relationship and direction.

Gratitude --DEPENDS_ON--> trust: the DEPENDS_ON test holds. Genuine gratitude (not mere polite acknowledgment) requires trust in the giver's goodwill. Without trust, the exchange collapses to transaction. Present-tense necessity is satisfied.

voting --DEPENDS_ON--> cognition: the note argues 'coercion requires a choice framework' which is about coercion, not voting. Even if voting requires cognitive capacity, that's too universal (Law 11c) — almost everything requires cognition. This is a true edge by universality, not a meaningful structural relationship.

coercion --DERIVED_FROM--> resistance: note says 'resistance is the constructive form that coercion takes' — but that reverses causality. Coercion (forcing compliance through threat) predates resistance as a social practice. Resistance is a RESPONSE to coercion, not its source. Chronology and causal direction are both wrong.
Pride does not depend on shame; one can experience pride without shame, and shame can exist without pride. These are complementary but not dependency-related emotions.
Gratitude does not depend on pride; one can feel gratitude without pride, and gratitude is about appreciation for others rather than self-evaluation.
Intent does not derive from repentance; intent as purpose precedes repentance which requires intent to change. The direction should be repentance DERIVED_FROM intent.
City is not a kind of self; a city is a social/political entity while self is individual identity. This instance-of edge is category error.
Grief does not derive from shame; grief arises from loss while shame arises from failure or inadequacy. These are distinct emotional experiences.

Symbols predate formal language — smoke signals, drum codes, and pictographs all function as symbols without language. Symbols do not depend on language; they ARE a pre-linguistic communication system.
Voting requires cognition — you need the mental capacity to understand the choice and cast a deliberate vote. Without cognition, there is no voter.

philosophy does not depend on worldview — philosophy operates by critical examination of worldviews, not by requiring one to function. Many philosophers deliberately adopt a questioning stance toward their own worldview.

ritual does not depend on season — many rituals are not tied to seasonal cycles (daily prayer, rites of passage, funerary rituals). The remove-it-now test fails: remove seasons as a concept and ritual continues to operate.

reading does not depend on sound — print-based reading (text on page, screen) requires no auditory faculty. The remove-it-now test fails: remove sound and reading of written text still works perfectly.
castle is not a kind of masonry — a castle is a fortified building/structure, while masonry is the craft or technique of building with stone/brick. A castle CONTAINS masonry but is not a kind of it.

honor did not derive from grief — honor is a status-concept rooted in social recognition of virtue or achievement. Grief is an emotional response to loss. No historical or conceptual lineage connects the emergence of honor to grief.

hospitality did not derive from guest — the practice of hospitality (hosting guests) predates the formal concept of 'guest' as an institution. More fundamentally, these are complementary concepts describing two sides of the same interaction, not a derivation relationship. Neither one came from the other.

gratitude did not derive from grief — these are distinct emotions with different triggers and functions. Gratitude responds to benefit received; grief responds to loss. No historical lineage connects one emerging from the other.

grief did not derive from gratitude — opposite of the gratitude/grief edge, these are still distinct emotions. Grief (response to loss) and gratitude (response to benefit) have different evolutionary and historical origins. Neither came from the other.

contempt depends on memory — contempt requires the capacity to remember past actions or characteristics of a target; without memory, one cannot form the judgment that underlies contempt. You must remember the slight or flaw to feel contempt for it.

play does not depend on time — while play occurs within time (all activities do), it does not require a conceptual framework of time to operate. Play is driven by curiosity, pleasure, and exploration, not by any specific relationship to the concept of time.

play does not depend on standard — play is often defined precisely by its freedom from rules and standards. While some play has conventions, play as a category thrives on improvisation and breaking standards, not depending on them.

border did not derive from nation — border (boundary demarcation) predates the modern concept of nation by millennia. Borders existed in ancient city-states, tribal territories, and empires. The nation-state is a recent development.

Pride does not DEPEND_ON shame as a present-tense necessity. One can feel pride without shame being its formal counterpart — pride as self-satisfaction operates independently. The note conflates psychological contrast with functional dependency. Shame facilitates pride's social meaning but is not constitutive.

Gratitude DERIVED_FROM grief claims historical primacy of grief, but gratitude (thankfulness for received value) is psychologically and historically as old as grief (recognition of loss). Neither clearly predates the other, and the 'positive inversion' argument is philosophical, not historical chronology. The which-came-first test is not met.

Note argues reading requires 'a language system' but the edge targets 'sound' — reading written symbols does not require sound (Braille, silent reading, sign language). The note's reasoning doesn't match the edge target. If anything, reading DEPENDS_ON language, not sound.

Direction reversal: edge says memory DEPENDS_ON identity, but the note says 'memory is required for identity' — the opposite dependency. Memory does not need identity to operate; rather, identity depends on memory. The arrow is backwards.

The concept of boundary/division predates the political construct of the nation.

Schema as a human-made cognitive framework needs language as its constitutive substrate — without language, schemas cannot be expressed, stored, or communicated as human constructs. The note correctly identifies language as the medium of schema persistence (Law 8a, constitutive not merely facilitative).

Generalization IS a specific process within learning — the ability to abstract patterns from instances and apply broadly. Direction specific→general holds per Law 9. Generalization is indeed a kind of learning mechanism.

Perspective DEPENDS_ON interpretation as constitutive — a perspective only functions through the interpretive framework that selects what is salient. Remove interpretation and the standpoint collapses into unoriented perception. Present-tense necessity.

Digital-ledger DEPENDS_ON writing as its constitutive substrate — a ledger is fundamentally a practice of recording. Remove writing and ledgers cease to exist as a practice. Present-tense necessity per Law 8.

Note says 'coercion fundamentally requires a choice framework' but edge is voting→cognition. The note discusses coercion, not voting. Note-target mismatch. Customary law DEPENDS_ON convention as its constitutive substrate — customary law IS formalized convention. Remove social conventions and customary law loses its entire mechanism. Present-tense necessity.

Model DEPENDS_ON conceptualization as constitutive — you cannot construct a model without forming conceptual representations of the domain. Remove conceptualization and model-building stops immediately. Present-tense necessity.

Retroduction IS a species of abduction (specific→general) — the edge type DEPENDS_ON is wrong. Retroduction is a form of abductive reasoning. This should be INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON. Misclassification.

Logistics does not DEPEND_ON trade — logistics (coordination of resources, movement, supply chains) exists independently of trade: military logistics, organizational supply chains, disaster response. Trade is one application of logistics, not its constitutive substrate. Present-tense test fails.

Argument DERIVED_FROM logic claims logic predates argument, but argument (persuasion, structured reasoning) predates logic (formal study of valid inference) historically and conceptually. Logic formalizes argument patterns; argument is the more general and older practice. The which-came-first test shows the edge is reversed.

Limen (threshold) DEPENDS_ON measurement as constitutive — the concept of a threshold requires a scale or measure against which to define the cutoff point. Without measurement, threshold has no meaning. Present-tense necessity.

Schema IS an organized pattern for classification — the edge type DEPENDS_ON is wrong. Schema IS classification (or at least IS a form of it), so this should be INSTANCE_OF. Misclassification per Law 9.

Edge is reversed. Border (boundary demarcation) predates the nation by millennia — ancient city-states, tribal territories, and empires all used borders before the modern concept of nation existed. logistics DEPENDS_ON trade is constitutionally true. Logistics exists to coordinate the movement and storage of goods — trade (exchange and transfer) provides the purpose and direction. Without trade/exchange, there is nothing to coordinate. Present-tense necessity passes.

fallacy DEPENDS_ON language is constitutionally true. A fallacy is a defect in reasoning as expressed through language; without language there is no structure for the error to inhabit. The note passes the remove-it-now test.
dissent DEPENDS_ON law is constitutionally true. Legal dissent is a procedural mechanism within law — removing law stops dissent from operating as a formal mechanism. Present-tense necessity passes.

criterion DEPENDS_ON language is constitutionally true. A criterion must be stated or statable in language to operate as a decision rule — without linguistic encoding, it collapses into unarticulated preference. Present-tense necessity passes.
verdict DEPENDS_ON court is constitutionally true. A verdict requires a court to produce it — remove the court and the verdict ceases to exist. Present-tense necessity passes.

pattern-recognition DEPENDS_ON category is too strong. Pattern recognition can operate without explicit categorization — infants recognize faces and objects without categorical knowledge. provision DEPENDS_ON language is constitutionally true. A provision IS a linguistic construct — it defines rights, conditions, or arrangements through language. Remove language and the provision vanishes. Present-tense necessity passes.

causation DEPENDS_ON inference is constitutionally true. We cannot identify, express, or use causal relationships without making inferences from evidence. Remove inference and causal reasoning ceases. Present-tense necessity passes.

cognitive-load DEPENDS_ON attention is constitutionally true. Cognitive load as a concept describes the allocation of limited attentional resources — remove attention and cognitive load becomes meaningless. Present-tense necessity passes.

proviso DEPENDS_ON language is constitutionally true. A proviso is a conditional clause whose function of suspending or conditioning a statement requires linguistic structure. Remove language and a proviso ceases to exist. Present-tense necessity passes.

Solstice is an astronomical event, not a kind of time. Time is the dimension in which events occur; solstice is an occurrence within it. The edge confuses temporal location with categorical membership.

Script IS a kind of tool (INSTANCE_OF), not dependent on it. A script extends a human capacity by being a tool itself. The DEPENDS_ON relationship is wrong — this is a classification error. A script does not need tool to operate; it IS a tool.

Compression does not constitutively depend on signal. Compression operates on data/files/memory/information independent of signal theory. Signal is one application domain, not a constitutive substrate. Compression on punched cards predates signal theory by decades.

Truth as a philosophical construct does not require language to operate. Truth can be applied through logic, math, and behavioral prediction without linguistic articulation. Language facilitates truth but is not constitutive of it — the DEPENDS_ON test requires present-tense necessity.

Wisdom as practical judgment does not require language to operate (Law 2b). Language facilitates expression but is not constitutive — pattern recognition and judgment operate without it. Removing language does not stop wisdom from operating.

Gamification is a methodology — applying game mechanics to non-game contexts. It does not constitutionally require a tool (Law 8). It may use tools instrumentally but the removal test fails: gamification operates via design principles, not tool dependency.

Indexing does not depend on taxonomy to operate now (Law 8). An index can be alphabetical, chronological, positional, or any organizing principle. Taxonomy is one possible basis, not a constitutive requirement.

Salience as a perceptual/attentional phenomenon does not constitutionally depend on memory (Law 8). Perceptual salience operates in the moment without recall. Memory enriches it but the removal test fails: salience still functions as noticeable prominence without memory.

Wisdom is a specific kind of knowledge — knowledge characterized by deep understanding, sound judgment, and practical application. A competent speaker would say 'wisdom is a kind of knowledge.' The direction is specific→general, Law 9 holds.

Rationality as a cognitive practice predates formal logic by millennia. Humans reason rationally without explicit logical frameworks — intuitive rationality exists independently. The removal test fails: remove formal logic and rationality still operates. Law 8: present-tense necessity is not met.

Method is a systematic procedure — at its core it requires classification to categorize steps, conditions, inputs, and outcomes. Without classification there is no structure, no categorization of what belongs where, no systematicity. Any method inherently classifies.

Intelligence does not depend on language to operate. Non-linguistic animals exhibit intelligence, pre-linguistic humans think and solve problems, and non-symbolic reasoning exists independently. The concept of intelligence maps to cognition, not to language.

Measurement can operate without language — tally marks, knotted cords, comparative placement of objects all perform measurement. Language extends measurement but does not constitute it. The removal test fails.

Reduction IS a methodology — it is itself a methodological approach (reducing a complex phenomenon to simpler components). Saying it depends on methodology is like saying a recipe depends on cooking. Reduction is the method itself.
